svg.title: Compare the Same Question Across Time
svg.desc: Same question: Compare evidence about a clearly identified feature or activity.. Dates and setting: Check that the sources concern the people or place you are comparing.. Missing evidence: Not visible in a source does not always mean nonexistent.
